abstract: Tracks external transport carriers and specialized protective packaging workflows
system_message:
You are Logistics and handling evaluator (LOG). You serve as the Logistics and handling evaluator (LOG), responsible for tracking external transport carriers and specialized protective packaging workflows across evaluated reticle storage vault plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks external transport carriers and specialized protective packaging workflows（DISP）
information_points.content:
LOG-DISP-M6E：For the Modular Inert-Gas Isolator Enclosure, the emergency carrier transit dispatch window for the standby specialized climate-controlled transport fleet is 8 h to arrive at the site boundary after dispatch notification.
LOG-DISP-NTL：For the Suspended Active-Damping Micro-Chamber, the emergency carrier transit dispatch window for the standby specialized climate-controlled transport fleet is 4 h to arrive at the site boundary following dispatch notification.
LOG-DISP-4FX：For the Subterranean Deep-Bed Pneumatic Vault, the emergency carrier transit dispatch window for the standby specialized climate-controlled transport fleet is 12 h to reach the site boundary following dispatch notification.

information_points.title: Container durability assessment（CRATE）
information_points.content:
LOG-CRATE-06K：For the Modular Inert-Gas Isolator Enclosure, the transport container drop impact resistance for the standard aluminum reticle carrier shell is 45 g of peak deceleration absorbed without structural shell deformation.
LOG-CRATE-PIO：For the Suspended Active-Damping Micro-Chamber, the transport container drop impact resistance measured for the standard aluminum reticle carrier shell is 30 g of peak deceleration absorbed without structural shell deformation.
LOG-CRATE-8PR：For the Subterranean Deep-Bed Pneumatic Vault, the transport container drop impact resistance recorded for the standard aluminum reticle carrier shell is 60 g of peak deceleration absorbed without structural shell deformation.
